name: opa
summary: Deploys the owned Open Policy Agent demonstration service and AAP policy examples.

lifecycle.idempotency: Reconciles owned OPA resources and named AAP templates.
lifecycle.failure_boundary: Stops before policy deployment when AAP, the cluster, or pinned policy content is unavailable.

readiness: The owned OPA service is ready and its AAP examples are present.

security.secret_storage: AAP authentication uses managed credentials and is not stored in this contract.
security.network_trust: Pinned policy content and AAP APIs use configured trust controls.
security.external_actions: No policy is enforced against customer workloads automatically.
